question: Will CNA-represented Kaiser Permanente nurses in California be on strike on October 29 or 30, 2026?

calls.reasoning: A strike on Oct 29 or 30 legally needs a 10-day notice delivered by Oct 19 or Oct 20. As of Kaiser's Oct 15 update no notice had been received, and NNU's press page through Oct 17 shows no Kaiser strike notice; no media report of one turned up. Only an Oct 30 strike with notice delivered on Oct 20 PT remains possible, and bargaining sessions on Oct 21-23 make that unlikely. CNA has a strike authorization and struck in sympathy in March 2026, so the chance is not zero. Human markets: none found on Polymarket or Manifold (harness search plus my own search); Kalshi and bookmakers were not searched directly and none surfaced in web results.

- Status quo: no strike; bargaining continues.
